name: Speak with Jennea
summary: In Goldshire, Zaldimar Wefhellt sends novice mages to Stormwind for further instruction. He directs apprentices who have advanced beyond basic training in Elwynn Forest to Jennea Cannon in the Wizard's Sanctum.

sections.title: A Call to the Wizard's Sanctum
sections.body: Zaldimar Wefhellt sends you from Goldshire to Stormwind City as your training advances. Your time learning elementary spells from local tutors in Elwynn's hamlets has run its course. In the Mage Quarter, the Wizard's Sanctum is where the kingdom's senior mages pursue arcane study and instruction. They coordinate magical matters across the realm.

sections.title: Matters of Kingdom Security
sections.body: Zaldimar says your report concerns the security of Elwynn Forest and Stormwind, not only your studies. In Stormwind, you report to Jennea Cannon, a mage who oversees local assignments. She is cautious about sharing grand secrets with a newly arrived apprentice, but your report begins your service to the wizarding order.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: Zaldimar Wefhellt, the mage trainer at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, sends you once your arcane skills have advanced enough.

faq.q: Where can I find Jennea Cannon?
faq.answer: Jennea Cannon is in the Wizard's Sanctum, in the center of Stormwind City's Mage Quarter.
The Wizard's Sanctum is a prominent magical spire in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. The kingdom's mages and arcane scholars use it as an academy, library, and base of operations.

faq.q: Why does Zaldimar send me to Jennea instead of handling it himself?
faq.answer: Zaldimar teaches young mages the fundamentals in Goldshire. Higher-ranking scholars such as Jennea Cannon oversee larger regional threats and specialized work affecting the realm from the capital.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Jennea Cannon?
faq.answer: Jennea sends you to investigate mysterious magical anomalies around Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Is this quest available to any class?
faq.answer: No. Only mages receive this rite of passage from village training into Stormwind's arcane society.

angles.text: As a mage, you leave rural spellcasting in Goldshire for formal work with the high mages at Stormwind's Wizard's Sanctum.
As an Alliance member, you rely on arcane vigilance from the capital to help protect Elwynn Forest and Stormwind.
